:::{#def-conditional-mutual-information}
#### Conditional mutual information

The **conditional mutual information** of
[discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$ and $Y$ given a third one, $Z$,
with finite entropies, <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
is the reduction in the [conditional entropy](#def-conditional-entropy) of $Y$ given $Z$
from also learning $X$:

$$I(X; Y \mid Z) \eqdef \entropyf{Y \mid Z} - \entropyf{Y \mid X, Z}.$$

:::
